catalog.name: entity:calendar.event
catalog.description: Complete definition of entity Calendar Event (calendar.event).

fields.name: description
fields.help: When synchronization with an external calendar is active, this description is synchronized         with the one of the associated meeting in that external calendar. Any update will be propagated there         and vice versa.

fields.name: privacy
fields.help: People to whom this event will be visible.

fields.name: effective_privacy
fields.help: Whether the event is private, considering the user privacy

fields.name: show_as
fields.help:
If the time is shown as 'busy', this event will be visible to other people with either the full         information or simply 'busy' written depending on its privacy. Use this option to let other people know         that you are unavailable during that period of time. 
 If the event is shown as 'free', other users know         that you are available during that period of time.

fields.name: is_organizer_alone
fields.help:
Check if the organizer is alone in the event, i.e. if the organizer is the only one that hasn't declined
        the event (only if the organizer is not the only attendee)

fields.name: active
fields.help: If the active field is set to false, it will allow you to hide the event alarm information without removing it.

fields.name: start
fields.help: Start date of an event, without time for full days events

fields.name: stop
fields.help: Stop date of an event, without time for full days events

fields.name: alarm_ids
fields.help: Notifications sent to all attendees to remind of the meeting.

fields.name: recurrence_update
fields.help: Choose what to do with other events in the recurrence. Updating All Events is not allowed when dates or time is modified

fields.name: rrule_type_ui
fields.help: Let the event automatically repeat at that interval

compute/related, so we need an onchange to set the start/stop values in the form view

This method is used to set the start and stop values of all day events.
The calendar view needs date_start and date_stop values to display correctly the allday events across
several days. As the user edit the {start,stop}_date fields when allday is true,
this inverse method is needed to update the  start/stop value and have a relevant calendar view.

definitions.documentation:
Outlook does not allow to modify time fields of an event if this event crosses
or overlaps the recurrence. In this case a 400 error with the Outlook code "ErrorOccurrenceCrossingBoundary"
is returned. That means that the update violates the following Outlook restriction on recurrence exceptions:
an occurrence cannot be moved to or before the day of the previous occurrence, and cannot be moved to or after
the day of the following occurrence.
For example: E1 E2 E3 E4 cannot becomes E1 E3 E2 E4
